feedback.title: Six digits broke the pattern that works for five
feedback.body:
Everything you got right was 4 or 5 digits — the value of the 5 in 53719 was spot on. Six digits is where it slipped.

In 807254 you need to count all six columns from the right before naming one. One extra column, one extra count.
🔑 Six digits? Count all six columns before you answer.

dominantError.description: Miscounts columns once a number reaches six digits; solid at four and five.

brief.instructions: Six-digit numbers only. Open with the column-counting method explicitly in the first hint of every question — count from the right, every digit, before naming one.
